context_requirements: Cells must express CDC42 and its downstream effectors (PAK, WASP/WAVE, IQGAP) for direct pathway inhibition.
Adherent cells with active Rho-family GTPase-dependent cytoskeletal and mitogenic signaling are more likely to show transcriptional consequences.
Cells with intact stress and p53/p21 responses can mount a secondary cytostatic transcriptional program.
Rapidly proliferating cells are more likely to show late proliferation-down signatures.
falsifiers: No change in CDC42 or canonical CDC42 effector genes at 6 h in any responsive line.
No late proliferation-down or G1/G2M arrest signature at 24 h despite clear growth inhibition.
A strong interferon or unfolded protein response at 6 h without cytoskeletal or Rho GTPase-related changes.
Identical transcriptional response to vehicle across all nine lines at both time points.
